preset.name: linux64-godot
preset.comment: Linux x86-64 CPU-only static libs, for linking into the Godot godot_physx module.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_STATIC_LIBRARIES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Static libraries, linked into the module.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_PROJECTS
cmakeSwitch.comment: CPU only; the GPU preset builds these.

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path, relative to the PhysX SDK root.
